us-national.method: All available public source entries including unranked entries; no rank cutoff. Explicit campus disambiguation and deduplication; NCES HD2024 campus domains and states.

us-lac.method: All available public FindingSchool 2027 entries without a rank cutoff, including unranked entries; deduplicated with Wheaton and St. John’s campuses disambiguated. Three pagination omissions repaired from official institution reports. This is not claimed to be a complete publisher export; unresolved tie-boundary gaps remain. Supplementary NCES liberal-arts institutions have their own separate cohort.

us-global.method: Public XuanXiao transcription, pages 1–7, including every institution tied at rank 299.

cn-double-first.method: All 147 institutions, encompassing the historical 985/211 institutions and their separately listed university identities. Keep original membership names when institutions have since renamed.

hk-subdegree.method: All provider-level isProper=1 entries; child departments are covered by their parent institution. Shared HKCT domain displays both institutional identities.

tw-general.edition: 114 academic year (official snapshot as of 2025-10-15; exported 2026-01-08)
tw-general.method: Official 體制=一般大學 rows. Other university categories are included only if independently selected by another cohort.

us-systems.edition: Official system and administrative-office directories, reviewed 2026-10-19
us-systems.method: Curated U.S. public university systems, community-college systems and central administrative offices. Record the organization and its official headquarters state, not one constituent campus. Per-record evidence documents official identities, domains and locations.

affiliated-campuses.edition: Official campus and affiliated-institution directories, reviewed 2026-10-19
affiliated-campuses.method: Curated independently named campuses, overseas campuses and joint universities of covered institutions. Retain each campus identity, its actual country/region and official domain evidence. Affiliations indicate relationships, not necessarily ownership. Shared parent email hosts cannot identify an individual campus without an explicit subdomain.

cn-moe-ordinary.method: Exact MOE institution-code joins to the MIT-licensed GlobalUniversityHomePages dataset and exact institution-name joins to published institutional edu/ac/gov/mil-class homepage hosts. Unverified/missing domains are not inferred; see mainland-domain-audit.json for all source members. Existing reviewed ranking/campus aliases remain intact.

cn-moe-adult.method: Exact MOE institution-code joins to the MIT-licensed GlobalUniversityHomePages dataset and exact institution-name joins to published institutional edu/ac/gov/mil-class homepage hosts. Unverified/missing domains are not inferred; see mainland-domain-audit.json for all source members. Existing reviewed ranking/campus aliases remain intact.

us-liberal-arts-reference.method: Official Carnegie 2021 Baccalaureate Colleges: Arts & Sciences Focus (C21BASIC=21) with published .edu institutional homepages, supplementing the public U.S. News transcription. Excludes known closed Birmingham–Southern/Wells/Magdalen. This classification is not a claim of current ranking membership.

tw-all.edition: 114 academic year, official directory exported 2026-01-08; rechecked 2026-10-19
tw-all.method: Every row in the official civil directory reviewed; bundle only institutions with an evidenced edu/ac/gov/mil-class host. Retain all 149 source members and record the excluded host identities. Official English names are optional, never fabricated; no president/person/contact fields are imported. Military/police institutions have a separate official-source supplement.

domainReference.method: Exact institution-name/domain alignment with reviewed aliases and official directory corrections; no fuzzy inference in the runtime.

GlobalUniversityHomePages.method: Use only records with an exact school-code match in the 2026 MOE list. Domain facts only; no English names imported.
